List agents registered in a project

Usage: am agents list [OPTIONS] [PROJECT_KEY]

Arguments:
  [PROJECT_KEY]  Project key (slug or human_key / absolute path). Positional alternative to -p/--project; defaults to the current directory when both are omitted (GH#209)

Options:
  -p, --project <PROJECT_KEY>  Project key (slug or human_key / absolute path)
      --format <FORMAT>        Output format: table, json, or toon (default: auto-detect)
      --json                   Output JSON (shorthand for --format json)
  -h, --help                   Print help
